notes.title: Patch upgrade v1.0.17
notes.notes:
Change log
[list]
[*] The beautification of the inactive window style. Keep the original style of the title bar and use a better border style, when the window is inactive.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch upgrade v1.0.16
notes.notes:
Version 1.0.16 patch notes.

-Auto stop the optimization when the game is stopped.
-Game probe detection can auto detect and optimize the games.
-An option to allow auto startup the application without steam client.
 
Make sure start button has been clicked and changed to red before starting games for detection. The new option is Advanced options->General->Start application on system startup->Don't start steam client.

notes.title: Patch upgrade v1.0.14
notes.notes:
Version 1.0.14 patch notes.

-Auto prompt of killing unnecessary process for saving more memory.
-Don't show non user friendly exception messages.
-Don't crash when removing an uninstalled non steam game.
-Be able to auto start when system startup

notes.title: Patch upgrade v1.0.10
notes.notes:
Version 1.0.10 patch notes.

-Super fast clearing memory in seconds.
-Show a warning message instead of crashing the app when launch a non steam game that's already deleted.
-Unable to detect HDD won't block displaying information of other hardware.

notes.title: What are we working on?
notes.notes:
Dear users,

Here are the great features we are working on.

[b]New feature[/b]
[list]
[*]Accelerate the speed of memory cleaning using parallel threads
[*]Auto prompt of killing unnecessary processes
[*]Hardware comparison analysis
[*]FPS benchmark analysis report export
[/list]
[b]Bug fix[/b]
[list]
[*]FPS tracking doesn't work for some games
[*]Hardware analyzer failure for some HDD
[/list]

notes.title: Patch upgrade v1.0.7
notes.notes:
Version 1.0.7 patch notes.

-Display precise memory of Nvidia GPUs like NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1080 Ti.
-Show error message when app crashes.
-No more crash on start of app.
-New translation of Finnish.

notes.notes:

notes.title: Upgrade to version 1.0.5
notes.notes:
Dear users,

We have solved several issues mentioned in the discussion board. Thank you very much for the feedback. Special thanks to TheLazyNoob who helps test and spboxer3 who helps do the translation.

[h1] Change log of version 1.0.5[/h1]
[olist]
[*]Loading games from all Steam libraries.
[*]Quick loading of 100+ games.
[*]Being able to run again after any crash. 
[*]Redo the translation of Traditional Chinese.
[/olist]

notes.notes:
Hi everyone,
